name: Best Bar
description: Gold progress, runs, and custom practice.

issues.info: Include your newest Geode log when reporting a problem.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Master switch for Best Bar and Gold Run.

show-best-bar.name: Full Gold Progress Fill
show-best-bar.description: Replace the stock red progress fill with a large shiny gold fill. Previously completed 100% levels display a full gold bar immediately; active best-chase attempts fill gold from the left edge to the current percentage.

show-best-label.name: Show Best Text
show-best-label.description: Show BEST under the real progress bar with an X until the saved level percentage is 100%, then show an animated golden checkmark.

animated-sparkles.name: Animated Sparkles
animated-sparkles.description: Animate the stronger full-bar glow, clipped shine sweep, ambient sparkles, gold diamond aura, and completion-check effects.

gold-current-label.name: Gold Best-Chase Text
gold-current-label.description: Turn the percent text gold when the current attempt reaches the saved best.

gold-flash.name: Golden Record Flash
gold-flash.description: Use a smooth two-pulse gold flash when a record is reached.

gold-shine.name: Performance-Safe Shine and Stars
gold-shine.description: Use a lightweight glow pulse and small star burst when a record is passed. The old full-screen shine sweep was removed to prevent gameplay frame hitches.

settings-ui-key.name: Settings UI Hotkey
settings-ui-key.description: Optional hotkey to open the quick Best Bar settings popup in-game. Leave blank / None to disable.

best-sound.name: Shiny Record Sound
best-sound.description: Play the custom Best Bar chime when you reach or beat a record.

pulse-label.name: Pulse Best Text
pulse-label.description: Briefly pulse the BEST text when a record is reached.

platformer-mode.name: Platformer Best Timer
platformer-mode.description: Track and display your fastest normal platformer completion time.

gold-run-mode.name: Gold Run Mode
gold-run-mode.description: Enable a separate platformer-only Gold Run speedrun mode with its own records, runs, finishes, and failures.

show-gold-run-button.name: Show Gold Run Button
show-gold-run-button.description: Show a Gold Run button in platformer pause menus and a smaller centered Gold Run button on platformer level pages.

show-gold-run-timer.name: Show Gold Run HUD
show-gold-run-timer.description: Show the Gold Run timer, Gold Best, run count, finishes, and failures near the top-right.

save-run-history.name: Save Gold Run History
save-run-history.description: Save the newest 20 Gold Run completions and failed runs for each level.

show-leaderboard-button.name: Main Menu Leaderboard Button
show-leaderboard-button.description: Add the redesigned Geometry Dash-style speedrun leaderboard to the existing right-side menu. Rows show player, time, level name, difficulty, rewards, level ID, and validity.

leaderboard-name.name: Leaderboard Name
leaderboard-name.description: Name shown beside your submitted Gold Run times. Maximum 24 characters.

leaderboard-api-url.name: Leaderboard API URL
leaderboard-api-url.description: Base URL of the included Cloudflare Worker leaderboard. Leave blank to use the fully saved local leaderboard only.

leaderboard-auto-refresh.name: Auto-Refresh Leaderboard
leaderboard-auto-refresh.description: Refresh the open online leaderboard every 15 seconds.

leaderboard-safe-mode.name: Gold Run Safe Mode
leaderboard-safe-mode.description: Block ranked Gold Runs while a major assist such as noclip, slow motion, speedhack, macro, teleport, or clickbot is loaded. Hitboxes and respawn-delay mods remain allowed.

submit-cheated-runs.name: Show Invalid Online Runs
submit-cheated-runs.description: Submit completed invalid runs so the leaderboard can display CHEATED / NOT VALID instead of silently hiding them. Invalid runs never replace ranked bests.

practice-mode.name: Show in Practice Mode
practice-mode.description: Display saved-best visuals in practice mode. Practice attempts never overwrite records.

custom-practice-mode.name: Custom Practice Mode
custom-practice-mode.description: Master switch for the custom practice range system. It only activates while playing in Geometry Dash Practice Mode.

custom-practice-pause-button.name: Custom Practice Pause Button
custom-practice-pause-button.description: Show the Practice Range button in the top-left of the pause menu while Custom Practice is active.

custom-practice-predefined-ranges.name: Predefined Start and Target
custom-practice-predefined-ranges.description: Enable per-level start and target percentages, the pause-menu editor, and automatic start teleporting.

custom-practice-checkpoint-start.name: Checkpoint Sets Start
custom-practice-checkpoint-start.description: Practice checkpoints stop behaving as respawn checkpoints. Placing one saves your current percentage and Y position as the custom starting point. When disabled, checkpoints are blocked during Custom Practice.

custom-practice-live-range.name: Live Start-to-Current Display
custom-practice-live-range.description: Replace the normal practice percentage with START - CURRENT. When disabled it displays the fixed START - TARGET range.

custom-practice-continue-after-target.name: Continue Past Target
custom-practice-continue-after-target.description: Do not stop the attempt at the target. The HUD adds the extra percentage passed, such as 3.37% - 5.98% + 1.02%. This is off by default.

custom-practice-auto-advance-target.name: Move Target Forward
custom-practice-auto-advance-target.description: When you survive past the target and later die, save the furthest reached percentage as the new target.

custom-practice-safe-spawn-search.name: Search for Safe Spawn Y
custom-practice-safe-spawn-search.description: Try nearby vertical positions when the requested starting point overlaps a collision block. If none are free, the exact requested position is used.

custom-practice-entry-mode.name: Range Entry Mode
custom-practice-entry-mode.description: Type Numbers, Preview, or Both. Both opens quick number inputs and also offers the draggable ghost preview.

custom-practice-set-start-key.name: Set Start Hotkey
custom-practice-set-start-key.description: Set the current location as the start while playing. Examples: F6, F7, RSHIFT, E.

custom-practice-set-end-key.name: Set Target Hotkey
custom-practice-set-end-key.description: Set the current location as the target while playing.

custom-practice-restart-key.name: Restart Range Hotkey
custom-practice-restart-key.description: Restart the current custom practice range from its saved start.

test-mode.name: Show in Start Position/Test Mode
test-mode.description: Display saved-best visuals in editor tests. Test attempts never overwrite records.

best-color.name: Best Bar Color
best-color.description: Color used for the fill, sparkles, labels, Gold Run HUD, and record flash.
